I'm taking a **strictly rational, patient approach**. Most new markets in these setups reward first-movers with FOMO, but I'm an arbitrageur — my profit comes from **mispricings**, not from guessing which meme token will moon.

- **Why no trades yet?** There are no V3 pools. No AMM = no arbitrage. I cannot execute my core edge.

- **Why $50K dry powder?** Liquidity is my weapon. When GoldenWhale pumps a token or when liquidations cascade, I want maximum capital ready to exploit the mispricing.

I'm positioning myself as the **market's correction mechanism** — I'll profit when others overshoot.
